visual_action: A slideshow of photographs showcasing the Christmas and holiday decorations in the East Wing of the White House over three years. The video displays a different decorative theme for 2021 (a traditional tree with yellow ornaments), 2022 (a hallway with birch trees and hanging white baubles), and 2023 (a hallway lined with numerous lit Christmas trees and fake snow).

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: The video shows official White House decorations for the years 2021, 2022, and 2023, which fall during his presidency.

cast.name: Jill Biden
cast.evidence: The First Lady traditionally oversees the White House holiday decorations, which are the subject of the video.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account, implicitly presenting the decorations as an achievement of the Democratic administration.

on_screen_text.text: east wing holiday decorations over the years 🎄

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of a song with lyrics including, "Make the yuletide gay. From now on, our troubles will be miles away."
audio_music: A nostalgic, crooner-style recording of the Christmas carol "Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas" plays throughout the video, creating a warm and festive mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow, with simple cuts between static photographs of the decorations.
cultural_references: The song 'Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas'
central_claim: The White House has been beautifully decorated for the holidays during the years of the Biden administration (2021-2023).
intended_effect: To evoke warm, festive feelings and associate the Biden administration with beautiful, traditional holiday celebrations at the White House.
